title: Creating a term writes a "Credit term created" row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Note your user name.
  • Choose a name that no term has for the new term, term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  6. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The field shows the name as typed.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • The toast "term A created" shows.

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The newest row reads Event "Credit term created", User (your user name), Details "term A: 14 days after the invoice date", with today's date and the time.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R3: “Each change saved after release adds one row. There is no Line column. "{rule}" is the term's Due column text (S1-R7). The Event and Details columns read:”
  • S12-R3 table, created: “A term is created (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) | "Credit term created" | "{name}: {rule}", for example "Net 14: 14 days after the invoice date"”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log events | "Credit term created", "Credit term edited", "Credit term deactivated", "Credit term reactivated", "Credit term deleted", "Default changed", "Customers moved" | Event column text, one row per saved change”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log details | "{name}: {rule}" (created, deactivated, reactivated, deleted); "Name: {old} → {new}" and/or "Due: {old rule} → {new rule}" (edited); "{old} → {new}" (default changed); "{n} customers from {from} to {to}", plus "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold (customers moved) | Details column text”
  • Key Decisions: “Every change on the Credit Terms page is recorded in an organization-wide Credit Terms Log (Story 12: Credit Terms audit log), and every customer moved by Move Customers also gets a note naming the old term, the new term and the user.”
